prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Path", "Select a ready-made digital pet or create a custom companion from your photos."]
1: ["Save Your Companion to Account", "Sign in now to lock in your official adoption certificate and sync your pet across devices."]
2: ["Your Pet Lives On Your Desktop", "Drag your pet anywhere on your screen. Right-click your pet to access settings, hide, or interact."]
3: ["Upload Photo or Choose a Template", "Upload your photo or pick one of our starter templates to generate your custom pet.", "Use Starter Template"]
4: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet", "Sign in with your email or social account to sync your pet and save progress.", "Returning user? Sign in with the same account you used previously to automatically restore existing pets."]
5: ["Creating Desktop Companion", "Rendering your pet's desktop sprites and animations."]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Finalize your pet adoption to receive your official certificate and 100 bonus pet treats!", "100 Bonus Treats Included"]
7: ["Your Pet is Ready!", "Click below to place your new pet directly onto your desktop workspace.", "Summon Pet to Desktop"]
8: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Your new desktop friend is just a few steps away.", "Onboarding takes about 2 minutes. Pick your favorite companion next!"]
9: ["Feel free to minimize this window. We will send a desktop notification when your pet is ready!", "Desktop notification enabled when rendering finishes."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or bonus items (100 bonus pet treats).
